name: Sagami Ayako
source:
The school's infirmary doctor. 

She has an impudent personality, and for some reason, she and Yuta get along well. She is not well received by the teaching staff because she is always sloppy, but she is popular among the students.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yara_syuugaku/chara.html]official site[/url]]
